milestones.description: Wrexham AFC sign Gabonese striker Musa Tine (17) as a free agent, agreeing a 4-year deal worth $17,000/week plus a $175,000 signing bonus. The 68-rated forward gives the club a genuine young No. 9 option behind Obi while Yacel Amrizi continues his recovery from injury.

FA Community Shield final confirmed: Wrexham AFC (Premier League champions) vs Manchester City (FA Cup holders), Wembley Stadium, Saturday 7 August 2027, kickoff 5:00 PM — the club's first-ever Community Shield appearance.
